_comment: 🔌️ References for the repo MCP module. The protocol cases are checked against Anthropic's own TypeScript SDK — a second, independently written implementation of the same specification, driven through an in-memory transport so it never links this repository's code. The hash chain is checked against Node's `crypto` SHA-256, which is the FIPS 180-4 reference every implementation's hand-rolled digest must reproduce.

oracles.rationale: The reference implementation of the Model Context Protocol, written by the authors of the specification. The oracle adapters run its `Server` over its own `InMemoryTransport` and speak raw JSON-RPC to it, so the expected handshake result, the expected listing shape and the expected error codes are produced by that implementation rather than transcribed from this repository's own code.

SHA-256 is hand-rolled inside every implementation of this module so the event chain carries no external runtime dependency. Node's `crypto` binding to OpenSSL is the FIPS 180-4 reference the hand-rolled digest is measured against.
